answer: We don't have a contract pharmacy

We purchase our 340b medications and birth control options through a variety of wholesale companies.  With such a high number of uninsured patients, we don't get paid for most of them so there are no profits to speak of to use for other projects.  For example, we pay $559.28 per Nexplanon.  3 out of 5 patients are uninsured so we will lose money because there will be little or no payment for the LARK.  Title X will only reimburse for that visit at about $73 a visit so we lose money on the visit itself as well.
